Comparing Claudes:

Sonnet 4.5 has a 8% longer time horizon point estimate than Opus 4.1. However, this difference isn’t statistically significant.

Its point estimate is 66% longer than Sonnet 4. This is statistically significant, with 4.5 beating 4 in 99% of bootstrap samples.
